identity.real_world_identity_notes: Mid-engine GTE car with a naturally aspirated flat six. Porsche's media guide specifies a weight-optimised six-speed sequential constant-mesh gearbox in a magnesium casing, shifted by an electronic actuator through steering-wheel paddles.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.porsche-911-rsr-gte.20260813t200336168z-ccc5802f by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behavior was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the manufacturer specifies the six-speed sequential paddle-shifted gearbox.

claims.basis: The manufacturer media guide establishes the 2019 911 RSR identity and its transmission, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The manufacturer specifies a six-speed sequential constant-mesh gearbox with an electronic shift actuator and paddles, and the live drive confirmed six paddle gears with clutch-free move-off.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

deviations.basis: Whether the car needs a throttle lift on upshifts is not established. A guided drive settles it, by holding the throttle through an upshift and seeing whether the gear engages.

notes: The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "prototype", a value that named a racing category rather than a rim outline. That value is retired: the rims it covered are the same closed form, flattened at both the top and the bottom, that the project now records as "gt-style". The shape was remapped by definition and the rim was not observed again.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
